# arin_irr_route_set (Data Source)

Read an IRR route set and its IPv4, multiprotocol, and by-reference membership.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by go generate.
# Set ARIN_API_KEY in the environment.
data "arin_irr_route_set" "example" {
  name = "RS-EXAMPLE"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Route set name, including a hierarchical name if applicable.

### Read-Only

- `creation_date` (String) creation date returned by ARIN.
- `description` (List of String) Ordered lines of description.
- `last_modified_date` (String) last modified date returned by ARIN.
- `members` (List of String) members returned by ARIN.
- `members_by_ref` (List of String) members by ref returned by ARIN.
- `mp_members` (List of String) mp members returned by ARIN.
- `org_handle` (String) org handle returned by ARIN.
- `poc_links` (Attributes List) poc links returned by ARIN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--poc_links))
- `remarks` (List of String) Ordered lines of remarks.
- `source` (String) source returned by ARIN.

<a id="nestedatt--poc_links"></a>
### Nested Schema for `poc_links`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) description returned by ARIN.
- `function` (String) function returned by ARIN.
- `handle` (String) handle returned by ARIN.
